responsibility: Declares the diagnostics buffering abstraction used by diagnostics::context to hold reported diagnostics temporarily instead of sending them immediately to sinks. It defines diagnostics::buffer as the cross-sink container that tracks per-kind counters and owns one sink-specific per_sink_buffer for each output format, plus the abstract per_sink_buffer interface that text, SARIF, HTML, and other sinks implement to store, move, clear, and flush their buffered representation of diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration side of the buffering pair: it introduces the diagnostics::buffer container and abstract per_sink_buffer interface that sink implementations subclass. Unlike buffering.cc, it does not perform context attachment or flushing logic; it defines the types and contracts that buffering.cc executes.
